node.statement: By node 1.3 the difference on the left is the zero-padded lower-right corner Co_Q(Y^dagger X)-Y^dagger X, whose norm equals the norm of that entry by the same corner-isometry argument as in node 1.2; node 1.2 also gives ||R_Y||=||Y|| and ||C_X||=||X||. Substitution and C_rc=C_co yield the claimed estimate.
